name: @chatfuel/vite-plugin-proxy
description: Chatfuel proxy for scaffolded apps (cors-proxy.md shape A): HTTP forward with server-side Authorization injection, REST passthrough for file uploads, a message-aware graphql-transport-ws relay that sends connection_init itself — the token never reaches the browser — and, in front of all of it, the Supabase auth gate (is this session a member of this tenant?). core.ts is host-agnostic; vite.ts mounts it on the dev server; server.ts is the production static+proxy server. The wizard vendors the whole src/ directory into scaffolded apps as vendor/chatfuel-proxy/.
